grammar: v. 比较；对比。compare A with/to B；compare ... with ... 可表示把两者作比较；名词 comparison。
collocations: compare prices; compare A with B; compared with last year
commonMistake: compare A with B 表示把 A 与 B 比较；不要漏掉介词 with/to。

example.english: The report compares the rainfall in two cities.
example.chinese: 这份报告比较了两座城市的降雨量。

application.prompt: We compared the two routes ___ find the shorter one. A. to B. for
application.solution: A。解析：compare 后接宾语；此处 to find 表示比较的目的。

grammar: adj. 害羞的；腼腆的。比较级 shyer/shier，最高级 shyest/shiest；可说 be shy about/of sth。
collocations: a shy child; feel shy; be shy about speaking
commonMistake: shy 的比较级可写 shyer 或 shier；描述人的性格用 shy，不用 ashamed。

example.english: The shy student spoke quietly at first.
example.chinese: 那个害羞的学生一开始说话很轻。

application.prompt: Tom is less ___ now and talks more with his classmates. A. lazy B. shy
application.solution: B。解析：less shy 表示“没那么害羞”。

grammar: adj. 懒惰的；懒洋洋的。比较级 lazier，最高级 laziest；副词 lazily。
collocations: a lazy afternoon; feel lazy; a lazy student
commonMistake: lazy 的比较级变 y 为 i 加 -er：lazier；副词为 lazily。

example.english: I felt lazy on the hot afternoon and stayed indoors.
example.chinese: 炎热的下午我懒得动，就待在室内。

application.prompt: Of the three dogs, the old one is the ___. A. laziest B. lazyest
application.solution: A。解析：lazy 的最高级变 y 为 i 加 -est，写作 laziest。

grammar: adj. 大声的；响亮的；adv. 大声地。作方式副词时常用 loudly；say/speak loudly。
collocations: a loud noise; speak loudly; turn the music up loud
commonMistake: loud 可作形容词或副词；正式表达“响亮地”常用 loudly。

example.english: The music was too loud for the small room.
example.chinese: 音乐对这间小房间来说太响了。

application.prompt: The speaker is too ___. Could you turn it down? A. loudly B. loud
application.solution: B。解析：be 动词后作表语用形容词 loud。

grammar: adj. 外向的；友善健谈的。常修饰人；名词为 outgoingness（较少用）。
collocations: an outgoing person; be outgoing and friendly; an outgoing personality
commonMistake: outgoing 描述乐于与人交往的性格；不要与 go out（外出）混为一谈。

example.english: Her outgoing nature helps her make friends easily.
example.chinese: 她外向的性格让她很容易交到朋友。

application.prompt: Leo enjoys meeting new people and starting conversations. He is ___. A. outgoing B. shy
application.solution: A。解析：喜欢认识新朋友、主动交谈说明性格 outgoing（外向）。

grammar: adj. 勤奋的；努力工作的。通常作定语或表语；比较级可用 more hard-working。
collocations: a hard-working student; be hard-working; hard-working staff
commonMistake: hard-working 是形容词，修饰名词；hardly 意为“几乎不”，不要混淆。

example.english: The hard-working team finished the project on time.
example.chinese: 这支勤奋的团队按时完成了项目。

application.prompt: She studies every evening and never gives up. She is ___. A. careless B. hard-working
application.solution: B。解析：持续认真学习体现 hard-working（勤奋）。

grammar: v. 表演；执行；表现。perform—performed—performed；名词 performer（表演者）、performance（表演/表现）。
collocations: perform on stage; perform a task; perform well
commonMistake: perform 可表示公开表演或执行任务；名词形式 performance，不是 performation。

example.english: The students performed a short play at the school festival.
example.chinese: 学生们在校园节上表演了一部短剧。

application.prompt: The band will ___ live at the community event. A. perform B. solve
application.solution: A。解析：乐队在活动中现场表演，用 perform。

grammar: adj./adv. 独自；单独。作形容词通常置于名词后或 be 后；表示“孤独的”常用 lonely。
collocations: live alone; leave sb alone; be alone at home
commonMistake: alone 只表示没有别人陪伴，不一定感到孤独；lonely 强调寂寞感。

example.english: My brother walked home alone after the game.
example.chinese: 比赛后我哥哥独自步行回家。

application.prompt: She lives by herself, but she doesn't feel ___. A. alone B. lonely
application.solution: B。解析：题干说明她独自生活但不感到寂寞，空格用 lonely；alone 仅指独自。

grammar: v. 解决；解答。常接 problem、puzzle、mystery；名词 solution，常用 a solution to sth。
collocations: solve a problem; solve a puzzle; solve the mystery
commonMistake: solve 常接 problem；answer 常接 question。表示“……的解决办法”用 solution to。

example.english: We worked together to solve the difficult puzzle.
example.chinese: 我们一起努力解开了这个难题。

application.prompt: The class discussed how to ___ the traffic problem. A. solve B. answer
application.solution: A。解析：problem 常与 solve 搭配；answer 多与 question 搭配。

grammar: n. 长笛。可数，复数 flutes；表示演奏乐器常用 play the flute。
collocations: play the flute; a flute player; flute music
commonMistake: 乐器前通常用 the：play the flute；表示吹奏长笛的人可说 flute player。

example.english: Ella began to play the flute when she was nine.
example.chinese: Ella 九岁时开始学习吹长笛。

application.prompt: Sam practices ___ flute after school. A. a B. the
application.solution: B。解析：play/practice 后接乐器名称时通常加 the。

grammar: n. 祝贺；恭喜。单数较少独立使用；常用复数 congratulations，或 offer/send congratulations。
collocations: congratulations on your success; offer congratulations; a letter of congratulation
commonMistake: 祝贺某人时通常用复数 Congratulations!；说明原因用 on + 名词/动名词。

example.english: We sent our congratulations on her graduation.
example.chinese: 她毕业时我们向她表示了祝贺。

application.prompt: Which is the natural way to congratulate a friend? A. Congratulations on your prize! B. Congratulation for your prize!
application.solution: A。解析：祝贺时常用复数 Congratulations，原因前用 on。

grammar: expr. （对……表示）祝贺！常用 Congratulations on + 名词/动名词；回应可说 Thank you。
collocations: Congratulations on your success!; Congratulations on winning!; offer sb congratulations
commonMistake: 祝贺的固定表达用复数 Congratulations；on 后接名词或动名词。

example.english: “Congratulations on your new job!” “Thank you!”
example.chinese: “祝贺你找到新工作！”“谢谢！”

application.prompt: Your classmate won first prize. You say, “___!” A. Good luck B. Congratulations
application.solution: B。解析：对已经获得的成绩表示祝贺用 Congratulations。

grammar: n. 奖；奖品；奖励。可数；win/receive a prize；prize 也可作形容词“珍贵的”。
collocations: win first prize; a cash prize; prize money
commonMistake: 表示获奖常说 win a prize；“奖项”与 price（价格）拼写相近，注意区分。

example.english: The winner received a prize for her painting.
example.chinese: 获胜者因她的画作获得了一份奖励。

application.prompt: He won first ___ in the school music competition. A. prize B. price
application.solution: A。解析：比赛中获得的是 prize（奖），price 意为价格。

grammar: v. 参加；出席；上（学）；照料。attend—attended—attended；参加会议/课程说 attend a meeting/class/school；表示照料用 attend to sb/sth。
collocations: attend a meeting; attend school; attend a wedding; attend to a patient
commonMistake: attend a meeting/school 中 attend 直接接宾语；attend to sb/sth 表示“照料”，不要把 to 加到 attend a meeting 中。

example.english: More than two hundred people attended the concert.
example.chinese: 两百多人参加了这场音乐会。

application.prompt: Maya will ___ the school concert on Friday. A. join to B. attend
application.solution: B。解析：参加会议、课程或活动可用及物动词 attend。

grammar: phr. 像……一样……。结构 as + 形容词/副词原级 + as；否定形式可用 not as/so ... as。
collocations: as tall as; run as quickly as; not as expensive as
commonMistake: as...as 中间用形容词或副词原级，不用比较级；两处 as 均不可省。

example.english: This route is as safe as the main road.
example.chinese: 这条路线和主路一样安全。

application.prompt: The new apartment is ___ large ___ the old one. A. as; as B. so; than
application.solution: A。解析：同级比较用 as + 形容词原级 + as。

grammar: prep./adv. 除……之外（还）；而且。作介词时表示包含在内；beside（没有 s）意为“在旁边”。
collocations: besides English; besides that; what besides?
commonMistake: besides 表“除……之外还”，包含所说内容；except 表排除；beside 意为“在……旁边”。

example.english: Besides English, she can speak Russian.
example.chinese: 除了英语，她还会说俄语。

application.prompt: ___ the guide, three students helped us find the station. A. Except B. Besides
application.solution: B。解析：句意表示除导游外还有三名学生帮忙，包含导游，故用 besides。

grammar: adj. 空闲的；备用的；v. 抽出（时间）；饶恕。常见 spare time、spare sb a minute、spare no effort。
collocations: spare time; a spare key; spare a few minutes
commonMistake: spare time 作“空闲时间”；spare 作动词表示抽出时可接时间或人。

example.english: Could you spare a few minutes to help me?
example.chinese: 你能抽几分钟帮帮我吗？

application.prompt: I keep a ___ key in my bag in case I lose the first one. A. spare B. serious
application.solution: A。解析：备用钥匙是 a spare key。

grammar: phr. 空闲时间。spare 作形容词修饰 time；常作不可数概念，常用 in one's spare time。
collocations: in my spare time; have some spare time; use spare time to read
commonMistake: 固定表达 in one's spare time；不要用 during my spare time 替代常见结构。

example.english: In her spare time, Lina practices the flute.
example.chinese: Lina 空闲时练习吹长笛。

application.prompt: ___ my spare time, I enjoy reading novels. A. On B. In
application.solution: B。解析：表示“在空闲时间”常用 in one's spare time。

grammar: n. 乐事；愉快；荣幸。常见 It's a pleasure to do sth；My pleasure 可回应感谢。
collocations: with pleasure; take pleasure in reading; a great pleasure
commonMistake: 回应感谢可说 My pleasure；pleased 是“感到高兴的”，pleasant 是“令人愉快的”。

example.english: It was a pleasure to meet your family.
example.chinese: 见到你的家人很荣幸。

application.prompt: “Thanks for showing me around.” “My ___.” A. pleasure B. pleasant
application.solution: A。解析：My pleasure 是回应感谢的礼貌表达。

grammar: phr. 有共同之处。常见 have a lot/much/nothing in common with sb；sth 可为特点、兴趣等。
collocations: have a lot in common; have little in common with sb; interests in common
commonMistake: 表示与某人有共同点用 have sth in common with sb；不要漏掉介词 with。

example.english: The two friends have a lot in common, including their love of music.
example.chinese: 这两位朋友有许多共同点，包括都热爱音乐。

application.prompt: We both enjoy hiking, so we have something ___ common. A. on B. in
application.solution: B。解析：固定结构为 have sth in common。

grammar: n. 外表；外貌；出现；露面。可数或不可数依义而定；动词 appear。
collocations: physical appearance; make an appearance; change one's appearance
commonMistake: appearance 可指外貌，也可指露面；不要与动词 appear 混淆词性。

example.english: People should not judge others by their appearance.
example.chinese: 人们不应以貌取人。

application.prompt: The twins look alike in ___. A. appearance B. opinion
application.solution: A。解析：look alike in appearance 表示外貌相似。

grammar: n. 性格；个性；人格。可数，复数 personalities；形容词 personal 表示“个人的”，含义不同。
collocations: a friendly personality; personality traits; have a strong personality
commonMistake: personality 表示性格；personal 表示个人的，不要混淆。

example.english: Her warm personality makes visitors feel welcome.
example.chinese: 她热情的性格让访客感到宾至如归。

application.prompt: His cheerful ___ helps him make friends easily. A. population B. personality
application.solution: B。解析：描述一个人开朗的性格用 personality。

grammar: adj. 严肃的；认真的；严重的。副词 seriously；常用 be serious about sth/doing sth。
collocations: a serious problem; look serious; be serious about learning
commonMistake: serious 可描述神情严肃、态度认真或问题严重；修饰动词用 seriously。

example.english: The doctor said the injury was not serious.
example.chinese: 医生说伤势不严重。

application.prompt: The weather report warns of a ___ storm tonight. A. serious B. spare
application.solution: A。解析：严重的风暴可用 serious 修饰。

grammar: n. 力量；优势；长处。可数或不可数依义而定；形容词 strong，副词 strongly。
collocations: physical strength; a person's strength; strength and weakness
commonMistake: strength 的形容词是 strong；表示“优势/长处”时常说 one of sb's strengths。

example.english: Patience is one of her greatest strengths.
example.chinese: 耐心是她最大的优点之一。

application.prompt: Working well in a team is one of his ___. A. strong B. strengths
application.solution: B。解析：one of 后接名词复数，且此处需要“优点”名词 strengths。

examTags: 熟词多义·苗条与微小可能性
grammar: adj. 苗条的；细长的；微小的（可能性）。比较级 slimmer，最高级 slimmest；变比较级时双写 m。
collocations: a slim figure; a slim chance; a slim book
commonMistake: slim 的比较级双写 m：slimmer；描述可能性时 a slim chance 表示机会很小。

example.english: There is still a slim chance of catching the last bus.
example.chinese: 赶上末班车仍有一线可能。

application.prompt: We have only a ___ chance of reaching the station before the train leaves. A. slim B. huge
application.solution: A。解析：时间紧，机会很小，可用 a slim chance。

grammar: n. 事实；现实。可数；常见 in fact（事实上）、the fact that...（……这一事实）。
collocations: a well-known fact; in fact; face the facts
commonMistake: in fact 是句子副词短语，意为“事实上”；不要与 fact（单个事实）混淆。

example.english: In fact, the town is much older than it looks.
example.chinese: 事实上，这座小镇比看起来古老得多。

application.prompt: I thought the museum was closed. ___, it was open until six. A. For example B. In fact
application.solution: B。解析：补充真实情况时可用 in fact（事实上）。

grammar: n. 人口。常用 the population of...；询问人口用 What is the population...?；修饰数量用 large/small。
collocations: the population of a city; a large population; population growth
commonMistake: population 表示人口总数时常作单数；问人口数量用 What is...，不说 How many people is...?

example.english: The population of the town is growing slowly.
example.chinese: 这个小镇的人口正在缓慢增长。

application.prompt: What ___ the population of this city? A. is B. are
application.solution: A。解析：the population 作整体概念，谓语通常用单数 is。

grammar: 缩写 n. 千米；公里，完整拼法为 kilometre（英）/ kilometer（美）。数值与 km 之间留空格，缩写不加复数 -s。
collocations: 5 km away; 10 km per hour; a 3-km walk
commonMistake: km 是 kilometre/kilometer 的缩写，大小写固定；数值后写 5 km，不写 5 kms。

example.english: The lake is about 8 km from the town centre.
example.chinese: 湖离镇中心约八公里。

application.prompt: The station is 4 ___ from our hotel. A. kms B. km
application.solution: B。解析：单位缩写 km 不加复数 -s。

grammar: adj. 平均的；平常的；n. 平均数；平均水平。on average 表示平均而言；the average of...。
collocations: average temperature; on average; an average of 20 mm
commonMistake: “平均而言”用 on average；average 作形容词直接修饰名词，如 average rainfall。

example.english: The average temperature is lower in January.
example.chinese: 一月份的平均气温更低。

application.prompt: ___, each student read four novels last year. A. On average B. In average
application.solution: A。解析：固定搭配为 on average，表示“平均而言”。

grammar: n. 降雨量；降雨。通常不可数；常与 high/low、heavy/light 连用，描述某地或某时期的降雨情况。
collocations: annual rainfall; heavy rainfall; average rainfall
commonMistake: rainfall 表示降雨量时通常不可数；不说 many rainfalls 表示雨量大。

example.english: The area gets less rainfall in winter.
example.chinese: 这个地区冬季降雨量较少。

application.prompt: This region receives very little ___ each year. A. rainfalls B. rainfall
application.solution: B。解析：表示降雨量的 rainfall 通常不可数。

grammar: prep. 每；每一。用于比率、价格和速度，如 per person、per year、kilometres per hour。
collocations: per person; per day; kilometres per hour
commonMistake: per 表示“每”，后接单位或时间段；不要与 percent（百分比）混淆。

example.english: The bus travels at 40 kilometres per hour.
example.chinese: 这辆公交车以每小时四十公里的速度行驶。

application.prompt: The hotel charges $80 ___ night for a single room. A. per B. during
application.solution: A。解析：表示每晚收费用 per night。

grammar: 缩写 n. 毫米，完整拼法 millimetre（英）/ millimeter（美）。数值与 mm 之间留空格；缩写不加复数 -s。
collocations: 5 mm of rain; 10 mm thick; measure in millimetres
commonMistake: 单位缩写写作 mm，不加 -s；数值与单位之间通常留空格，如 20 mm。

example.english: The rainfall reached 30 mm yesterday.
example.chinese: 昨天的降雨量达到三十毫米。

application.prompt: The board is 12 ___ thick. A. mms B. mm
application.solution: B。解析：毫米缩写 mm 不加复数 -s。

grammar: adj. 宜人的；令人愉快的；友好的。pleasant 描述事物/经历；pleased 描述人的感受；副词 pleasantly。
collocations: pleasant weather; a pleasant surprise; pleasant to talk to
commonMistake: pleasant 表示“令人愉快的”；人感到高兴用 pleased，感到愉快不说 pleasant。

example.english: We had a pleasant walk by the river.
example.chinese: 我们在河边散步，感觉很惬意。

application.prompt: We enjoyed the ___ weather during our visit. A. pleasant B. pleased
application.solution: A。解析：weather 是令人愉快的事物，用 pleasant；pleased 描述人的感受。

grammar: n. 差异；不同之处。可数，复数 differences；常用 the difference between A and B。
collocations: a big difference; the difference between two places; make a difference
commonMistake: difference 表示“差异”；常说 the difference between A and B，不说 difference of A and B。

example.english: There is a clear difference between the two maps.
example.chinese: 这两张地图之间有明显差异。

application.prompt: Can you tell me the ___ between these two pictures? A. different B. difference
application.solution: B。解析：the 后需要名词 difference；different 是形容词。

grammar: adj./adv. 相像的；相似地。作形容词时通常置于 be/look/seem 后；不能直接放在名词前。
collocations: look alike; be alike in appearance; treat people alike
commonMistake: alike 通常作表语，不说 an alike person；名词前用 similar，如 similar people。

example.english: The sisters look alike, but their personalities are different.
example.chinese: 这对姐妹看起来相像，但性格不同。

application.prompt: The two brothers look very ___. A. alike B. alikes
application.solution: A。解析：alike 作表语不加词尾 -s。

grammar: n. 镜子；v. 反映；映照。可数，复数 mirrors；动词过去式 mirrored。
collocations: look in the mirror; a full-length mirror; mirror someone's feelings
commonMistake: mirror 作“镜子”是可数名词；look at yourself in the mirror 表示照镜子。

example.english: She checked her appearance in the mirror before leaving.
example.chinese: 离开前她照镜子检查了一下自己的仪表。

application.prompt: I looked at my face in the ___. A. novel B. mirror
application.solution: B。解析：照看自己的脸要用 mirror（镜子）。

examTags: 熟词多义·兴趣与使感兴趣
grammar: n. 兴趣；爱好；利息；v. 使感兴趣。常用 be interested in sth/doing；interesting 描述令人感兴趣的事物。
collocations: have an interest in music; show interest in; interest sb
commonMistake: 人对某事感兴趣用 be interested in；事物令人感兴趣用 interesting。

example.english: The museum's model trains interested the children.
example.chinese: 博物馆的火车模型让孩子们很感兴趣。

application.prompt: Ella is interested ___ learning about local history. A. in B. on
application.solution: A。解析：固定搭配 be interested in，介词后接名词或动名词。

grammar: n. 小说；adj. 新颖的（较正式）。可数名词，复数 novels；指篇幅较长的虚构作品。
collocations: read a novel; a historical novel; a novel idea
commonMistake: novel 作名词是“小说”；形容词 novel 表示新颖的，注意与 adjective new 的语体差异。

example.english: She borrowed a novel from the library for the weekend.
example.chinese: 她从图书馆借了一本小说，准备周末看。

application.prompt: The book tells a long fictional story. It is a ___. A. mirror B. novel
application.solution: B。解析：篇幅较长的虚构故事是 novel（小说）。

examTags: 熟词多义·感觉与意识到
grammar: n. 感觉；理解力；意识；v. 感觉到；意识到。常用 a sense of humour、make sense。
collocations: a sense of direction; make sense; sense danger
commonMistake: make sense 表示“有道理/讲得通”；make sense of sth 表示“理解某事物”。

example.english: The directions make sense when you look at the map.
example.chinese: 看着地图，这些路线说明就讲得通了。

application.prompt: I can't ___ why the bus is late without checking the traffic report. A. make sense of B. take care of
application.solution: A。解析：make sense of 表示“理解、弄明白”。

grammar: n. 幽默；幽默感，通常不可数。英式拼写 humour，美式拼写 humor；形容词 humorous。
collocations: a sense of humour; have a good sense of humour; British humour
commonMistake: 按教材使用英式拼法 humour；美式拼法 humor 含义相同。

example.english: His sense of humour made the long journey more enjoyable.
example.chinese: 他的幽默感让漫长的旅程变得更愉快。

application.prompt: She can always make us laugh. She has a great sense of ___. A. humorous B. humour
application.solution: B。解析：sense of 后接名词 humour；humorous 是形容词。

grammar: phr. 多亏；由于；因为。后接名词或代词，表示原因；可用于正面或中性结果。
collocations: thanks to your help; thanks to the good weather; thanks to modern technology
commonMistake: thanks to 后接名词性成分；表示负面原因时也可用，但注意上下文语气。

example.english: Thanks to the clear map, we found the museum easily.
example.chinese: 多亏了清晰的地图，我们很容易就找到了博物馆。

application.prompt: ___ the driver's help, we reached the station on time. A. Thanks to B. Instead of
application.solution: A。解析：司机的帮助是按时到达的原因，用 thanks to。

grammar: n. 看法；意见。可数；常用 in one's opinion、have an opinion about/on sth。
collocations: in my opinion; share an opinion; ask for sb's opinion
commonMistake: 表达“依我看”用 in my opinion；询问意见可说 What's your opinion of/about...?

example.english: In my opinion, the train is the easiest way to travel.
example.chinese: 依我看，乘火车是最方便的出行方式。

application.prompt: ___ my opinion, both routes are safe. A. On B. In
application.solution: B。解析：固定表达为 in my opinion。

grammar: phr. 犯错误。可说 make a mistake，也可说 make mistakes；过去式 made a mistake。
collocations: make a spelling mistake; make a mistake in a test; learn from mistakes
commonMistake: mistake 是可数名词；泛指犯错常用 make a mistake/make mistakes。

example.english: I made a mistake when I copied the address.
example.chinese: 我抄地址时犯了一个错误。

application.prompt: Everyone can ___ from time to time. A. make a mistake B. do a mistake
application.solution: A。解析：英语中说 make a mistake，不说 do a mistake。

grammar: adj./adv./pron. 较少的；更少地；较少。通常修饰不可数名词；比较级 little 的形式，反义词 more。
collocations: less time; less expensive; spend less
commonMistake: less 通常修饰不可数名词，fewer 修饰可数名词复数；less 是 little 的比较级。

example.english: We had less time than we expected, so we took a taxi.
example.chinese: 我们比预想的时间少，所以坐了出租车。

application.prompt: There is ___ rainfall here in winter than in summer. A. fewer B. less
application.solution: B。解析：rainfall 通常不可数，用 less；fewer 修饰可数名词复数。

grammar: adj. 简单易懂的；坦率的；直接的。可作定语或表语；副词 straightforwardly。
collocations: a straightforward question; a straightforward explanation; be straightforward with sb
commonMistake: straightforward 可指事情简单，也可形容人坦率；由语境判断，不等同于 straight（笔直的）。

example.english: The instructions are straightforward and easy to follow.
example.chinese: 这些说明简单明了，容易照着做。

application.prompt: The directions were clear and simple. They were ___. A. straightforward B. serious
application.solution: A。解析：straightforward 可表示“简单易懂的”。

grammar: adj. 诚实的；坦诚的。名词 honesty；honest 以元音音素开头，单数前用 an。
collocations: an honest person; be honest with sb; an honest answer
commonMistake: honest 的 h 不发音，因此说 an honest answer；honestly 是副词。

example.english: Please be honest with me about what happened.
example.chinese: 请坦诚地告诉我发生了什么。

application.prompt: He admitted his mistake and gave ___ answer. A. a honest B. an honest
application.solution: B。解析：honest 的首音为元音音素，前用 an。

grammar: adj. 直接的；率直的；v. 指引；指导；导演。副词 directly；directly 可表示“直接地/立即”。
collocations: a direct answer; direct sb to a place; a direct train
commonMistake: direct 可作形容词或动词；副词为 directly；direct train 指直达列车。

example.english: Could you direct us to the nearest metro station?
example.chinese: 你能告诉我们去最近地铁站的路吗？

application.prompt: The hotel clerk ___ us to the lift. A. directed B. direction
application.solution: A。解析：句中需要动词，directed 是 direct 的过去式。

grammar: n. 相似之处。可数，复数 similarities；常用 similarity between A and B；形容词 similar。
collocations: a striking similarity; similarities between two places; look for similarities
commonMistake: 名词为 similarity，形容词为 similar；“A 与 B 相似”用 be similar to。

example.english: There are many similarities between the two towns.
example.chinese: 这两个小镇有许多相似之处。

application.prompt: We noticed a strong ___ between their ideas. A. similar B. similarity
application.solution: B。解析：a strong 后需要名词 similarity。

grammar: n. 友谊；友情。通常不可数；形容词 friendly 表示友好的，friend 是朋友。
collocations: a close friendship; build a friendship; value friendship
commonMistake: friendship 表示抽象的友谊，通常不可数；friendly 是形容词，不是 friendship 的副词。

example.english: Their friendship grew stronger as they worked together.
example.chinese: 他们在合作中建立了更深厚的友谊。

application.prompt: The story is about the ___ between two classmates. A. friendship B. friendly
application.solution: A。解析：the 后需要名词 friendship；friendly 是形容词。

grammar: n. 米，长度单位。可数，复数 metres；英式拼写 metre，美式拼写 meter。数值后可作单位。
collocations: two metres long; a 100-metre race; metres above sea level
commonMistake: 按教材用英式拼写 metre；美式拼写 meter 也表示米，但 meter 还可指测量仪表。

example.english: The pool is twenty metres long.
example.chinese: 这个游泳池长二十米。

application.prompt: The room is six ___ wide. A. metre B. metres
application.solution: B。解析：数值 six 后用复数单位 metres。

grammar: n. 王子；亲王。可数，复数 princes；女性对应词为 princess。
collocations: a young prince; the prince of Wales; a prince and princess
commonMistake: prince 是男性王子，princess 是公主；拼写注意 prince 结尾为 -ce。

example.english: The prince greeted the visitors at the palace.
example.chinese: 王子在宫殿迎接了来访者。

application.prompt: In the story, the king's son is a ___. A. prince B. pauper
application.solution: A。解析：国王的儿子可称为 prince（王子）。

grammar: n. 人物；性格；特点；文字/字符。可数；the main character 指主要人物。
collocations: a main character; a strong character; Chinese characters
commonMistake: character 可指故事人物或性格，也可指文字；结合语境判断具体含义。

example.english: The main character in the novel learns to be more honest.
example.chinese: 小说中的主人公学会了变得更加诚实。

application.prompt: The ___ in the story is a brave young prince. A. rainfall B. character
application.solution: B。解析：故事中的人物用 character 表示。

grammar: n. 贫民；穷人（较正式，文学语境常见）。可数，复数 paupers；现代日常英语更常用 poor person。
collocations: a poor pauper; a pauper's life; prince and pauper
commonMistake: pauper 是较正式或文学用词，意为极贫困的人；不要误认为 paper（纸）。

example.english: The tale tells of a prince who meets a pauper.
example.chinese: 这个故事讲述了一位王子遇见一名穷人的经历。

application.prompt: A person with very little money may be called a ___. A. pauper B. prince
application.solution: A。解析：pauper 指贫民；prince 指王子。

grammar: v. & n. 交换；交流。exchange A for B 表示以 A 换 B；exchange ideas/addresses。
collocations: exchange gifts; exchange ideas; exchange A for B
commonMistake: exchange A for B 表示用 A 换 B；exchange sth with sb 表示与某人交换某物。

example.english: The students exchanged addresses before the trip.
example.chinese: 旅行前学生们互留了地址。

application.prompt: We ___ small gifts with our host family. A. expected B. exchanged
application.solution: B。解析：互相交换礼物用 exchange sth with sb。

grammar: n. 意外；事故。可数；常见 by accident（偶然）、have an accident（出事故）。
collocations: a traffic accident; have an accident; happen by accident
commonMistake: by accident 表示“偶然地”；accident 是可数名词，单数前常用 an。

example.english: Luckily, no one was hurt in the accident.
example.chinese: 幸运的是，事故中没有人受伤。

application.prompt: The glass broke ___ when I moved the box. A. by accident B. in common
application.solution: A。解析：表示意外地、偶然地用 by accident。

grammar: phr. 偶然；意外地。作状语，修饰动词；反义表达 on purpose（故意地）。
collocations: meet by accident; break sth by accident; happen by accident
commonMistake: by accident 与 on purpose 意思相反；注意按语境选择。

example.english: I found the old photo by accident while cleaning the drawer.
example.chinese: 我清理抽屉时偶然发现了这张旧照片。

application.prompt: She didn't mean to send the message to everyone; she did it ___. A. on purpose B. by accident
application.solution: B。解析：didn't mean to 表明并非故意，因此是 by accident。

grammar: v. 预料；期待；认为。expect to do sth、expect sb to do sth、expect that...；名词 expectation。
collocations: expect a visitor; expect to arrive; expect sb to help
commonMistake: expect 后接不定式或宾语 + 不定式；“期待某人做某事”用 expect sb to do。

example.english: We expect the bus to arrive in ten minutes.
example.chinese: 我们预计公交车十分钟后到达。

application.prompt: The guide expects us ___ at the museum by nine. A. to arrive B. arriving
application.solution: A。解析：expect sb to do sth 后接带 to 的不定式。

grammar: adj. 银色的；n. 银（金属）。表示材质的银通常不可数；颜色可作定语或表语。
collocations: a silver ring; silver hair; made of silver
commonMistake: silver 可指银这种金属，也可描述银色；形容物品颜色时常作定语，如 a silver car。

example.english: She wore a silver necklace to the concert.
example.chinese: 她戴着一条银色项链去听音乐会。

application.prompt: The medal is made of ___. A. situation B. silver
application.solution: B。解析：奖章的材质是银，可用名词 silver。

grammar: n. 内衬；衬里。可数，复数 linings；由 line（给……加衬里）加 -ing 构成。
collocations: a jacket lining; the lining of a coat; a silver lining
commonMistake: lining 指衣物或容器的内衬；silver lining 是“困境中的一线希望”的比喻表达。

example.english: The coat has a soft lining to keep you warm.
example.chinese: 这件外套有柔软的内衬，可以保暖。

application.prompt: The warm ___ inside the jacket makes it comfortable in winter. A. lining B. rainfall
application.solution: A。解析：衣服里面用于衬托和保暖的一层是 lining（内衬）。

grammar: phr. 一线光明；困境中的积极一面。常见 every cloud has a silver lining，意为“黑暗中总有一线希望”。
collocations: a silver lining; find a silver lining; every cloud has a silver lining
commonMistake: 该短语用比喻义表示坏事中仍有好的一面；不是“银色的衬里”的字面描述。

example.english: Losing the game had a silver lining: we learned how to work better as a team.
example.chinese: 输掉比赛也有积极的一面：我们学会了如何更好地团队合作。

application.prompt: The cancelled trip was disappointing, but we spent a fun day together at home. That was a ___. A. traffic accident B. silver lining
application.solution: B。解析：不愉快事情中出现的好处可称为 a silver lining。

grammar: n. 情况；状况；处境。可数，复数 situations；常用 in a difficult situation、the present situation。
collocations: a difficult situation; in this situation; improve the situation
commonMistake: situation 是可数名词；表示“在这种情况下”常说 in this situation。

example.english: The guide stayed calm in a difficult situation.
example.chinese: 导游在困难情况下保持了冷静。

application.prompt: The road is closed, so we need to change our plan. We must deal with the ___. A. situation B. personality
application.solution: A。解析：需要处理的是眼前的情况，用 situation。

grammar: phr. 关心；在意；担心。about 为介词，后接名词、代词或动名词；care for 可表示照顾或喜欢。
collocations: care about the environment; care about what others think; really care about sb
commonMistake: care about 表示关心/在意；照顾某人常用 care for 或 take care of。

example.english: Many students care about protecting the environment.
example.chinese: 许多学生关心保护环境。

application.prompt: She always listens to her friends and wants to help them. She ___ them. A. looks for B. cares about
application.solution: B。解析：在意并关心朋友用 care about。

grammar: v. 到达；伸手够到；达到（数量/水平）。及物动词，后直接接地点，不与 arrive at/in 的介词搭配。
collocations: reach the station; reach for a book; reach an agreement
commonMistake: reach 后直接接地点，如 reach the station；不要说 reach to the station。

example.english: We reached the station just before the train left.
example.chinese: 火车开走前我们赶到了车站。

application.prompt: After a long walk, we finally ___ the village. A. reached B. arrived
application.solution: A。解析：空格后有地点名词 village，reach 是及物动词，直接接地点。

grammar: phr. 伸手去拿；伸向。reach 为动词，for 后接想拿到的对象；reach for sth 不表示已经拿到。
collocations: reach for a glass; reach for the phone; reach for the top shelf
commonMistake: reach for 表示伸手去够某物；表示已经够到或拿到用 reach/grab/take。

example.english: He reached for the handle but couldn't open the door.
example.chinese: 他伸手去够门把手，但没能打开门。

application.prompt: The book is on a high shelf, so she stood on tiptoe to ___ it. A. care about B. reach for
application.solution: B。解析：伸手去够高处的书用 reach for。

grammar: v. 触碰；触动（情感）；n. 触觉；触摸。touch—touched—touched；常用 touch sth gently。
collocations: touch the screen; touch someone's heart; keep in touch
commonMistake: touch 可指身体接触，也可指情感上使人感动；keep in touch 表示保持联系。

example.english: The story about the lost dog touched many readers.
example.chinese: 这个关于走失小狗的故事打动了许多读者。

application.prompt: The film was so moving that it ___ the audience. A. touched B. exchanged
application.solution: A。解析：touch 可表示“打动、触动（某人的情感）”。

examTags: 语言运用·请求与提供帮助
grammar: phr. 帮助某人；搭把手。lend sb a hand 或 lend a hand to sb；lend—lent—lent。
collocations: lend me a hand; lend a hand with the bags; lend a helping hand
commonMistake: lend a hand 表示帮忙；lend 的过去式是 lent，不是 lended。

example.english: Could you lend me a hand with these boxes?
example.chinese: 你能帮我搬一下这些箱子吗？

application.prompt: The table is heavy. Can you ___ and move it? A. take a novel B. lend me a hand
application.solution: B。解析：请求帮忙可用 lend sb a hand。
